title: Present Simple
grammarNote:
Present Simple — одно из самых важных времён английского языка. Мы используем его для четырёх главных случаев:

① Привычки и рутина — то, что ты делаешь регулярно:
   "I get up at 6:30 every day." / "She studies English every morning."

② Факты и постоянные истины — то, что всегда верно:
   "Water boils at 100°C." / "Kazakhstan is in Central Asia."

③ Расписания и программы — официальные тайминги:
   "Classes start at 8:30." / "The library closes at 8 pm."

④ С наречиями частоты — always, usually, often, sometimes, never:
   "I always make my bed." / "He never skips breakfast."

⚠️ ГЛАВНОЕ ПРАВИЛО: если подлежащее He / She / It — добавляй -s к глаголу!
"I work → She works" · "You study → He studies" · "They go → It goes"

grammarTable.subject: I / You / We / They
grammarTable.example: I study. · You work. · We live. · They go to WKU.

grammarTable.subject: He / She / It
grammarTable.example: She studies. · He works. · It takes 10 minutes.

grammarExtra.title: Spelling rules — правила написания +s для He/She/It

rows.example: work → works · read → reads · eat → eats · call → calls
go → goes · watch → watches · finish → finishes · do → does
study → studies · carry → carries · try → tries
play → plays · say → says · stay → stays · pay → pays
I have a laptop. → She has a laptop. (НЕ "haves"!)

rows.form: I / You / We / They + don't + verb
rows.example: I don't eat meat. · They don't study on Sundays.
She doesn't wake up early. · He doesn't skip class.
✅ She doesn't work. ❌ She doesn't works.

rows.form: don't = do not · doesn't = does not
rows.example: I do not have time. = I don't have time.
Do you study every day? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Does she get up early? — Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
✅ Does he work? ❌ Does he works?
What do you eat? · Where does she study? · When does it start?
How often do you call your parents? — Every evening.
I always make my bed. · She always arrives on time.
I usually eat porridge. · He usually studies after class.
We often go to the library after lunch.
She sometimes skips breakfast. · I sometimes feel tired.
He rarely misses a class. · I rarely watch TV.
I never press snooze! · She never forgets her homework.
BEFORE main verb: "I always study." · AFTER "to be": "She is always tired."

grammarTip:
Три главных "убийцы" Present Simple — запомни раз и навсегда:

① He/She/It → всегда +s/es/ies на глагол:
   "She study" ❌ → "She studies" ✅

② Отрицание и вопрос с He/She/It → используй DOESN'T / DOES, и глагол без -s:
   "She doesn't studies" ❌ → "She doesn't study" ✅
   "Does she studies?" ❌ → "Does she study?" ✅

③ Сигнальные слова Present Simple:
   every day / week / morning · always · usually · often · sometimes · never · on Mondays · at 8:30

exercises.hint: Aizhan = She → She gets up. He/She/It + verb+s.

exercises.text: Dias ___ breakfast every morning — he only has tea.
exercises.hint: Dias = He → doesn't + base form. Never "doesn't eats".

exercises.instruction: Write the correct form of the verb.
exercises.text: Zarina ___ (do) yoga every morning for ten minutes.
exercises.hint: Zarina = She → does. He/She/It + does for the verb "do".

exercises.text: "She don't study on Sundays" is correct English.
exercises.hint: She → doesn't. "She doesn't study on Sundays." — never "don't" with He/She/It.

exercises.text: ___ Aizhan listen to podcasts on her way to class?
exercises.hint: Aizhan = She → Does she listen...? (base form after Does).

exercises.instruction: Write the correct form of the verb "study".
exercises.text: I ___ English every day, but my brother ___ Computer Science.
exercises.hint: I → study (no change). My brother = He → studies (y→ies).

opts: I eat always porridge for breakfast.
Always I eat porridge for breakfast.
I always eat porridge for breakfast.
I eat porridge always for breakfast.
exercises.correct: I always eat porridge for breakfast.
exercises.hint: Adverbs of frequency go BEFORE the main verb: "I always eat..."

opts: She don't goes to the cafeteria.
Does he studies hard every evening?
They doesn't have a class on Fridays.
He never skips his English lesson.
exercises.correct: He never skips his English lesson.
exercises.hint: "He never skips" = He + verb+s ✅. Others all have errors with don't/doesn't/does.
